**1 — Scene:** A light meal of thick corn-and-shredded-ingredient soup, two salmon sushi rolls, a leafy salad, a milky hot drink, and water.

**2 — Vessels:** Estimated soup bowl diameter 15 cm (177 cm²); sushi side plate 20 cm (314 cm²); salad plate 20 cm (314 cm²). Mug diameter approximately 8 cm (50 cm²); water glass approximately 7 cm (38 cm²). Both food plates appear to belong to this meal.

**3 — Items:** Soup with visible corn and shredded ingredients; salmon sushi; lettuce; cherry tomatoes; pale cucumber-like slices; milky tea or coffee; water. No distinct oil or dressing is visible, so none is added.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **454 g of food and 252 kcal**, or **844 g and 282 kcal including drinks**, is plausible for the visible small soup bowl, two sushi pieces, and loose salad. Soup composition and milk content are the largest energy uncertainties.
